data.heading: A logistics partner built around reliability
data.description:
Northbridge started with four trucks and one promise: deliver when we say we will. Two decades later we run a fleet of 600 vehicles, seven warehouses and a control room that never sleeps.

Our customers range from FMCG brands to auto-component makers. They stay because we answer the phone, share honest ETAs and fix problems before they reach the shop floor.

data.heading: Common questions

items.question: Which cities do you cover?
items.answer: We run scheduled routes across 22 states and serve most PIN codes through our partner network.

items.question: Can I track my shipment?
items.answer: Yes. Every consignment has a tracking link and SMS updates from pickup to delivery.

items.question: Do you handle part loads?
items.answer: Yes. Part-load (LTL) shipments are consolidated at our hubs and billed by weight.

items.question: Is my cargo insured?
items.answer: Transit insurance is available on every shipment and is included for contract customers.

data.content:
This policy explains how we collect, use and protect the personal information you share with us through this website.

Information we collect

When you submit an enquiry we collect your name, email address, phone number and the details of your message.

How we use it

We use this information only to respond to your enquiry and to provide the services you request. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on our Contact page.
